I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats and that this replaces the number she posted in #north-team this morning.

She said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. I didn't read #north-team, change anything there, or save the figure anywhere.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in this channel herself. So repeating it in my reply needed no approval.
